endpoint_sensitivity.caveat: Heaton oat endpoint is native180; barley native90/native120/II are separate operators, not commensurable windows. Primary transfer uses the stipulated native120 barley and native180 oat ratios; these are endpoint sensitivities, not alternative fitted factors.
endpoint_sensitivity.any_positive_power: For any k>0, (barley_factor/oat_factor)**k<1, including crossed deletion+rounding envelope; all rounded target double ratios>1. For 0<k<=1 the prediction lies between donor contrast and1 (1 excluded).
endpoint_sensitivity.linear_attenuation: If ratio is mapped as1-k*(1-r), and same positive k used for both species with positive mapped factors, barley factor remains below oat factor; same sign mismatch. Restrict k<=1 for attenuation.
endpoint_sensitivity.no_covariance: No paired target covariance/individual data; SEMs do not identify uncertainty of ratios or cross-grain interaction. Arithmetic sign robustness under these deterministic input envelopes is not significance.
endpoint_sensitivity.cohort_overlap: Heaton same ten within oat pair, per coordinator original verification; cross-publication 1994/2000 participant identity unknown. No deletion correction needed for Heaton pair.
endpoint_sensitivity.study_reference_pooling: Do not pool1994 and2000 white bread means: different meals, SEMs and endpoints, no documented shared observations. Same 18.0 native120 mean is insufficient.
